style.voice: cinematic narrative with director-led scene breakdowns
style.tone: dramatic episodic storytelling optimized for 60-second short-form

review_policy.notes: All review nodes execute a two-step process: business review (narrative structure, direction quality, visual consistency, Seedance 2.0 spec compliance) followed by compliance review (platform content policy: no real-person restrictions, no copyrighted IP, no political sensitivity, no extreme violence). Both gates must PASS to advance; on FAIL, all feedback is merged, the agent revises once, and the director re-reviews.

naming.artifact_convention: Episode outputs: outputs/ep{NN}/{seq}-{stage}.{ext}; shared facts: assets/{type}-prompts.json; reviews: runtime/reviews/{story}-{gate}.json
